title: Create: Terrainational
description: Client-Server Modpack Neoforge with great terrain, create and other additions
body:
## ⚙️ Project: Aether-Mechanical Vistas
Limitless Horizons. Infinite Automation.
Aether-Mechanical Vistas is a premium 1.21.1 experience designed for those who believe Minecraft should look as grand as the machines we build within it. By merging the mechanical complexity of Create with groundbreaking rendering technology and sweeping, realistic terrain, this pack transforms the world from a sandbox into a living, breathing continent.

### 🏔️ Visuals & Exploration
Experience views previously impossible in Minecraft. By utilizing Distant Horizons (or Voxy) alongside custom-tuned shaders, your render distance is no longer measured in chunks, but in kilometers.

- The Great Scale: Featuring Tectonic and Lithosphere for massive mountain ranges, deep valleys, and realistic geological formations.
- Infinite Sight: Integrated LOD (Level of Detail) technology allows you to see your distant industrial outposts from across the world map.
- Atmospheric Depth: Pre-configured for Iris Shaders, specifically optimized for a "Steampunk-Naturalist" aesthetic.

### 🛠️ The Age of Engineering
At the heart of the pack lies Create 0.6.1+, expanded with a curated suite of addons to ensure your factories are as functional as they are beautiful.

- Logistics Redefined: Build massive rail networks with Steam ‘n’ Rails that span the realistic Tectonic continents.
- Industrial Integration: Seamlessly bridge the gap between kinetic power and logistics with Create Crafts & Additions and Enchantment Industry.
- Moving Bases: Full support for large-scale contraptions and chunk-loading for mobile industrial platforms.

### 🗺️ Navigation & Utility
Stay oriented in a world that is truly vast.

- Xaero’s Suite: Fully integrated Minimap and World Map with 3D terrain shading enabled to match the world-gen.
- Optimized Performance: Powered by the Sodium/Lithium/Indium stack, ensuring that even with shaders and complex machinery, your frame times remain consistent.

### 📋 Technical Note
Mod Loader: Fabric 1.21.1
Recommended RAM: 8GB for Clients | 12GB+ for Servers
Shader Recommendation: Complementary Reimagined or Bliss (optimized for DH).
